description:
The surah that contains the first revealed verses of the Quran, reminding the human being of **The Clinging Mass**, a stage that reflects the miracle of human creation in the womb of the mother. The surah is also known by the first Quranic instruction: Read. It is named after "the clining mass" (ʿalaq) mentioned in verse 2. The first five verses are known to be the first revelation of the Quran when the Prophet Muḥammad was instructed to read. The second part came later to show that man transgresses when he becomes self-satisfied.
The surah is also known as Clots of Blood, Proclaim, Read, Recite, The Blood-clot, The Clinging Clot, The Clinging Form, The Clot, The Embryo

translations.1: _Read_ in the Name of _your_ Lord who created;
translations.2: created man from a clinging mass.
translations.3: _Read_, and _your_ Lord is the most generous,
translations.5: taught man what he did not know.
translations.7: when he considers himself without need.
translations.8: Indeed to _your_ Lord is the return.
translations.11: tell me, should he be on [true] guidance,
translations.13: tell me, should he call him a liar and turn away
translations.14: —does he not know that Allah sees?
translations.15:
No indeed! If he does not stop,
 We shall seize him by the forelock,
translations.17: Then let him call out his gang!
translations.18: We [too] shall call the keepers of hell.
translations.19:
No indeed! Do not obey him,
 but prostrate and draw near [to Allah]!
